subject: Renewal gating: HelioMed procurement portal sync and onboarding refresh
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Julian Park <julian.park@heliomed.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 4 Feb 2027 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal gating: HelioMed procurement portal sync and onboarding refresh

Hi Julian —

Thanks for the good conversation yesterday. Per our note, HelioMed's renewal for the enterprise plan is approaching and you indicated you want to process via your procurement portal rather than a manual PO. To avoid a lapse and to accommodate the capacity increase you requested (+30% committed GPUs), here’s the proposed ask from our side: 

- Redwood to supply an updated SOW (attached) that reflects the +30% capacity and the two-month term shift (renew on 2027-05-01).
- HelioMed to upload the signed PO to your procurement portal ticketing flow and share the ticket URL.
- We’ll open a procurement-gate runbook so our ops team can finish onboarding (KMS config, VPC peering checklist) once PO is received.

Deadlines we’d like to hit: PO submitted by Tue 2027-02-09, signed SOW by Thu 2027-02-11, so we can schedule the provisioning window week of 2027-02-21. If those dates don’t work, let me know your constraints.

I’ve attached SOW-Redwood-HelioMed-v2.pdf with the capacity and term changes tracked. Also copying Neha for portal onboarding steps.

Thanks —
Camila Reyes
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0219

Attachments: SOW-Redwood-HelioMed-v2.pdf

From: Julian Park <julian.park@heliomed.com>

Subject: Re: Renewal gating: HelioMed procurement portal sync and onboarding refresh

Camila —

Thanks for the SOW. A couple quick questions before I kick this to procurement:

1) Can you confirm the not-to-exceed amount for the PO (we need an invoiceable figure for our portal).
2) Is the +30% quoted as a capacity addendum (one-time) or an amendment to the annual commit?
3) Our procurement portal needs a Redwood vendor code and SOC2 attestation. Do you have a vendor ID or a pointer for the SOC2 report?

We will create a portal ticket once we have the PO amount and the vendor code. If you have a short PO template we prefer that to speed upload (we can accept an Excel PO).

—Julian
Julian Park
Senior Procurement Manager, HelioMed
julian.park@heliomed.com

Julian —

Good questions. Quick answers below and next steps:

1) PO amount: For immediate procurement purposes, use a not-to-exceed of $172,500 for the first year (this includes the +30% capacity addendum prorated across the remaining term). Final invoiced amounts will match the signed SOW.
2) Capacity: The +30% is structured as an amendment to the annual commit (line item in SOW v2). We can add a one-time billing credit if HelioMed prefers smoothing — Ben (cc’d) can confirm pricing/credits.
3) Vendor / SOC2: Redwood vendor code is RW-5872. Our SOC 2 Type II summary is in the onboarding packet (I attached redwood-procurement-onboard.pdf). Full SOC artifacts can be shared under an NDA if needed.

Next steps I propose:
- Julian to open procurement portal ticket and attach PO (use PO_template.xlsx attached).
- HelioMed procurement to select "Vendor Onboarding - Renewal" category.
- We’ll provide DocuSign for the SOW; once signed, Marcus will coordinate the provisioning window.

If that timeline works, please open the ticket and paste the URL back here. Ben — can you confirm if the credit option is available and how fast we can adjust the invoice?

Thanks,
Camila

Attachments: PO_template.xlsx, redwood-procurement-onboard.pdf

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Procurement Team <procure@heliomed.com>, Julian Park <julian.park@heliomed.com>

Date: Mon, 8 Feb 2027 10:01:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood procurement onboarding checklist + ticket guidance

Hi Julian / HelioMed procurement —

Looping in the formal onboarding steps so your procurement team has a checklist for the portal upload. Please reference our portal guide (attached). Steps: 

1) Create a ticket in the portal and select category: Vendor Onboarding - Renewal.
2) Attach the PO using the provided PO_template.xlsx. Include vendor code RW-5872 in the vendor ID field.
3) Attach signed SOW (we’ll send DocuSign link) and SOC2 summary. If your portal requires a W-9/I9 equivalent, let us know and we’ll route to finance.
4) For capacity increases: add the amendment line item and check the box for "Provision on acceptance" so our provisioning team is alerted automatically.

Portal ticket expectations: once uploaded, allow 48–72 business hours for procurement review. If you need expedited handling (same-week provisioning), mark ticket as "expedite" and we will prioritize the rollout but may need a billing hold until the PO clears.

DocuSign for SOW will be sent by Camila momentarily.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Customer Onboarding Ops
Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai

Attachment: redwood-procurement-onboard.pdf
